topPRs.title: refactor: migrate Next.js → Vite SPA + Hono Workers (squash of shaw/refactor)
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Squash of [`shaw/refactor`](https://github.com/elizaOS/cloud/tree/shaw/refactor) onto `develop`. **1,260 files changed, +134,789 / −4,539.** Single commit, clean fast-forward of `develop`'s tip (`ce886784f`).

The branch had diverged ~4.4K commits from develop in both directions, with conflicts in 236 files. Rather than weaving thousands of micro-conflicts through a normal merge, we squashed shaw/refactor's tree on top of develop and auto-resolved overlap with `-X theirs` (shaw/refactor wins on text conflicts) — the new architecture is what we want everywhere it overlaps with develop's older shape. develop's NEW files (services/operator/*, OpenRouter pricing work, etc.) survived untouched on top.

## What this brings in from `shaw/refactor`

**Architectural cutover:**
- Next.js App Router → **Vite + React Router SPA** (`apps/frontend/`)
- API routes: Next-shape handlers → **Hono Workers** (`apps/api/`), auto-mounted via `apps/api/src/_router.generated.ts`
- Workspace restructure: `packages/apps/* → apps/*`
- Legacy `app/...` Next.js tree removed (intentional deletion preserved through the merge)

**SPA dashboard build-out** (every legacy `/dashboard/*` ported):
- 28 new pages under `apps/frontend/src/dashboard/**/Page.tsx` + 4 layouts (admin, chat-build, api-explorer, dashboard)
- 17 new typed data hooks under `apps/frontend/src/lib/data/*` (admin, affiliates, agents, analytics, api-keys, apps, chat, containers, credits, earnings, gallery, invoices, knowledge, mcps, milady, organizations, voices)
- All routes wired in `apps/frontend/src/App.tsx` with hover-preload via `lazyWithPreload`

**New Worker routes (Hono, codegen-mounted):**
- `POST /api/billing/checkout/verify` — Stripe session-retrieve fallback for the success page (replaces the legacy server-side flow)
- `GET /api/analytics/breakdown` + `GET /api/analytics/projections` — full shape `AnalyticsPageClient` needs
- `GET /api/v1/video/usage` + `GET /api/v1/video/featured` — real data from `generations` table (no fixtures)
- `GET /api/v1/milady/agents/:agentId` — converted Next-shape → Hono (was previously unmounted, so all calls were silently 404'ing); now also exposes admin-only Docker / SSH / bridge fields gated on `adminService.isAdmin`

**Auth bug fix (the visible one):**
- `POST /api/auth/steward-session` previously returned `401 Invalid token` whether the token was actually invalid OR the Worker was missing `STEWARD_SESSION_SECRET`. `AuthTokenSync` couldn't tell, so on misconfigured Workers every login was instantly wiped from localStorage and the user bounced back to `/login`. Now: `503 server_secret_missing` for the config case, `401 invalid_token` for true revocations, and the client only clears localStorage on the latter.

**Visual / copy:**
- Landing hero: "Monetize your agents" / "Eliza Cloud is everything you need to bootstrap and monetize agents and AI apps" / single "Get Started Free" CTA
- Header padding fixed (logo + buttons no longer flush against the edge)
- Feature cards now have real backing against the gradient
- Footer: "ELIZA CLOUD" copyright (was MILADY), Token + Blog removed
- Footer no longer below the fold

## What survives from `develop`

The +121K lines on top of shaw/refactor's tree:
- `services/operator/*` (Pepr capabilities operator)
- OpenRouter pricing rewrite + provider refactor (PR #482, embedding pricing backfill, /endpoints route coverage)
- Other develop-only commits since the branch point

## Worth eyeballing during review

A handful of files where both branches edited the same spot heavily; `-X theirs` may have lost a develop-side tweak:

- `packages/lib/services/ai-pricing*.ts`, `packages/lib/services/model-catalog.ts` — develop's openrouter pricing work landed here
- `packages/lib/services/oauth/providers/oauth2.ts`
- `proxy.ts` (+251 lines net)

If openrouter pricing or oauth tokens break on the preview deploy, look here first.

## Test plan

- [ ] Cloudflare Pages PR preview deploys successfully
- [ ] `/` landing page renders with new hero copy + footer above the fold
- [ ] `/login` → sign in (any provider) → does NOT bounce back to `/login` (the `steward-session` 401 fix)
- [ ] `/dashboard/milady` mounts after login
- [ ] `/dashboard/analytics` renders with real `AnalyticsPageClient` (breakdown + projections)
- [ ] `/dashboard/billing/success?session_id=…` invokes the new verify endpoint and updates the credit balance
- [ ] `/dashboard/admin` is gated on admin role; admin Docker/SSH/bridge details show on `/dashboard/milady/agents/:id` for admins only
- [ ] OpenRouter pricing + provider routes still work on the preview (verify the develop-side work survived the squash)
- [ ] `bun run --cwd apps/frontend typecheck` clean for the changed paths
- [ ] `bun run --cwd apps/api codegen && bun run --cwd apps/api build` clean

## Notes for reviewers

- The original `shaw/refactor` branch is preserved on origin as a paper trail.
- A `.env.vercel.production` file with 197 production secrets had been accidentally committed earlier on `shaw/refactor`; it was scrubbed via `git filter-repo` before this PR, and `.env.vercel*` / `.env.staging*` are now in `.gitignore`. Per separate notification, all those secrets were rotated. This PR's history does not contain the file.

topPRs.title: fix(compat): OpenRouter model id parity for usage, pricing, and catalog
topPRs.author: odilitime
topPRs.body:
Normalize xai/x-ai and mistral/mistralai spellings across catalog lookup, model status, pricing resolution, tiers, and usage analytics. Group usage and cost breakdowns on SQL keys aligned with canonicalUsageGroupingModel so top-N model rankings stay correct after merge.

Prefer logical provider keys when tie-breaking duplicate ai_pricing rows. Add docs, changelog entries, and unit tests including SQL parity checks.

Grok Code Fast defaults use OpenRouter x-ai/ id in app builder lists.

Made-with: Cursor

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> Touches billing-critical pricing resolution and analytics grouping (including SQL `GROUP BY` changes), so incorrect normalization could alter cost attribution or break pricing lookups despite added tests.
> 
> **Overview**
> Ensures xAI and Mistral identifiers are treated consistently across the stack by introducing shared translation/normalization helpers in `model-id-translation.ts` (candidate expansion, provider key normalization, canonical usage grouping, and persisted pricing provider key expansion).
> 
> Wires this normalization into model availability checks, OpenRouter catalog lookup, allowlisted chat-model enforcement (`isAllowedChatModel`), tier resolution, provider inference, and pricing resolution (including deterministic tie-breaks when duplicate `ai_pricing` rows exist under different namespaces). Usage analytics are updated to merge spellings correctly: model/provider breakdowns now normalize in SQL `GROUP BY` where needed (to keep top-N rankings correct under `LIMIT`) and merge+sort in TypeScript for full-set views.
> 
> Adds unit tests covering cross-module compatibility and SQL parity, updates a few default model ids to OpenRouter form (`x-ai/...`), and documents the rationale/operational guidance in `docs/openrouter-model-id-compatibility.md` with changelog/README links.
> 
> <sup>Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 43e42bedb213b305b69214de73cb63ede72b6128. Bugbot is set up for automated code reviews on this repo. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).</sup>

topPRs.author: 0xSolace
